scenario_description:
Objective: Complete Thursday’s Joliet scrimmage diagnostics with the loaner calibration bridge available before teams power up radios.
Emerging Need: A release code is irrelevant while spare equipment is unassigned, then becomes a missing prerequisite once the bridge is placed in an unstaffed radio locker for the pre-desk arrival.
Decision Context: Recognizing the preparation window requires linking the locker notice with stored JJC vestibule rules and the cabinet identifier, not the schedule alone.
Consequence: After the remote-release list exports, the trip can still continue, but the bridge cannot be released before the early diagnostics slot.

parameter.title: JJC scrimmage field-control diagnostics
parameter.description: Early radio-table diagnostics before practice matches; spare calibration bridge availability still pending.

parameter.subject: Thursday diagnostics arrival details
parameter.body: Thanks for covering the early diagnostics block. Vestibule badge entry starts at 06:45, and shop staff begin at 07:30. We are still checking whether the spare calibration bridge will be needed or whether the teams can use their own unit.

parameter.description: Round trip Chicago-Joliet fare for Thursday morning diagnostics

parameter.content: Update for Thursday: the spare calibration bridge is now assigned to your diagnostics block. It will be left in the radio-locker bank, cabinet RL-17, because the shop counter will not be staffed during your 06:45 arrival window.

parameter.subject: Remote-release export completed for Thursday morning lockers
parameter.body: The Thursday 05:30-07:30 radio-locker remote-release list was exported at 16:00 today. New additions received after export will be handled after the shop counter opens Thursday morning.
